tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// jo bo lugs kyi dzam+bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs sogs cha tshang ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzam+bha la sī ta pañtsa de ba sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dzam+bha la dkar po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ phyi chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ zangs gzhong nang du 'phags pa'i sku rab gnas byas pa bzhag pa la/ rang spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pā ṇir bsgom/ bum pa nas nor bdag gi spyi bo na mar la chu blug cing*/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa grangs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing chu mu tig gi phreng bar bsam/ nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal nas kyang mu tig gi phreng ba'i dngos grub byung bar bsams la/ chu sbyin no// mchod bstod byas te chu thigs mtheb srin gyis rang gi lce thog tu blangs la dngos grub zhu/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ chu phyogs bzhir gtor la yig brgya bzla/ zas nam mkha'i char ltar 'bab bo// nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ dkar gsum sogs ci 'byor gyi gtor ma bshams la/ btung ba'i tshogs mang du blug yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlab cing*/ nor lha gtso 'khor lnga mdun du spyan drangs nas/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha'i mjug tu ba ling+ta btags la dbul lo// 'dod don gsol ba btab pas nor sprin ltar 'du'o// gsang ba ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ rdza'i ga'u legs pa gcig byas la ga'u de'i nang du 'bru rnyed tshad skar ma bre'i nyin par blug go /lug gi nyi ma la gser dngul zangs lcags sogs rin po che rnyed tshad dang*/ sha mar thud bu ram sbrang rtsi sogs zas zhim pa rnyed tshad skar ma rgyal la bsag go /'bri g.yag ba glang ra lug sogs g.yang can gyi sems can gyi nam 'tshong gi spu rnyed tshad skar ma nag pa dang*/ sbo la gsog cing ga'ur blug mi phyug po g.yang can gyi lag nas byung ba'i gos dar sman bzang drug sogs rnyed tshad g.yang skar bzang po la bsag go

/rdzas de rnams ga'u'i nang du sna tshang bar bsag go /de nas nor bdag gi sku rab tu rin po che'am sa las grub pa'am/ bris sku'am/ rin po che brdar bas lder sku byas kyang chog ste/ sor bzhi las mi chung ba'i sku bzhengs ngo*// de nas mi phyug po g.yang can gyi khang pa'i sa dang*/ dge bshes bzang po bzhugs pa'i gzims khang gi sa dang*/ phyug po dang sde pa'i zhing sa dang bcas pa la rin po che dang khang sa bzang po bsres la 'brang rgyas mtheb chen rtse mo tsam bya/ de nor bdag gi thugs kar gzhug rin po che dang dar la sogs pa sna tshang re'i rdzas rnams gzhug go /de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng ga'u bzhag la dar gyis dgab/ mchod pa ci 'byor pa dbul/ de nas ga'u de rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i khang bu zhig tu bsgom/ de'i dbus su dzam̐ las nor bdag dzam+bha la sku mdog dkar po 'brug la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pas be con bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs shing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig tu gsal bar bsgom/ de'i shar du rdo rje ḍā ki nī nam mkha'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje/ g.yon pas rten 'brel gyi nor rdzas bsnams pa/ lhor rat+na ḍā ki nī sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon pas bum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma ḍā ki nī sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon pas 'gugs byed kyi lcags kyu bsnams pa/ byang du las kyi ḍā ki nī sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon pas ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa/ de thams cad rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i tshul gyis gar stabs dang ldan pa'o// de nas sgrub pa po mtshams dam par bsdams la mi dang tshig ma 'dres par/

oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bzla'o// de ltar sgrub pa byas nas dbang po rab zhag bdun/ 'bring nyer gcig tha na zla ba gcig nas rtags 'di ltar yod nges so// khrom mang po tshogs pa dang*/ 'bru'i gseb tu nyal ba dang*/ tshur phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ char chen po 'ong ba rmis pa ni grub pa'i rtags yin no// rtags byung ba dang ga'u de 'bru'i gseb bang mdzod du mis ma mthong bar bya'o// dus rtag tu srod la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag la sngags 'di bzla'o// tad+ya thā/ oṃ tshom+me le du ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa re bzlas na zas 'du bar 'gyur ro// jo bo'i zhal nas sngags 'di ma chag na skyid dar yong 'dug gsungs so// rtags tshang ba'i mjug tu mi snying sgul ba'i sngags/ oṃ pi shā ni swā hā/ zhes pi shā ni'i gsham du ming spel rnams bcug la nor bdag gi thugs kar gzhug go /swā hā'i gong du gzhug go /thabs de ltar byas nas ga'u khang pa na yod pa tsam gyis zas nor 'du ba yin gsungs so// des gar mthong ba dbang du bsdu bar bya ba ni/ ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i ri bo bya dang ri dwags mang ba/ ri dpyad legs par ma 'khyugs pa/ ri gzhan gyi chu rnams kho'i phyogs su babs pa/ shin tu bkra shis pa'i ri la thabs 'di ltar bya'o// rdza'i ga'u legs pa lnga byas la nang du sna tshang ba'i sngar gyi rdzas rnams blug ga'u'i nang du/ karma ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces so// ga'u lnga ka la/ oṃ pi shā ni yul mi phyug po dang*/ rgyal po dang blon po nor bzang po sogs dbang du 'du ba'i ming spel rnams swā hā'i gong du bcug la ga'u de ri thang mtshams su sba'o// mgyogs byed rta'i spu lha mo'i sked pa la bcings pas myur du 'ong ba'i thabs yin gsungs/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī la'ang ga'u'i nang du sku bcug la rdzas gong bzhin gyi steng du dbang po lag pa la sogs pa klu sman rnams blug go

/lha mo'i thugs kar/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni/ ming spel rnams swā hā/ klu chen po sogs gong 'dod kyi ming spel byas la/ ga'u de lung pa'i chu mgo la sba'o// chu de 'thung ba tsam gyis dbang du 'gyur ro// rdo rje ḍā ki nī'i thugs kar/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi shā ni steng lha'i srid pa/ 'og klu'i srid pa/ bar mi'i srid pa thams cad bdag gi dbang du sdus shig ces bcug la ga'u de ri mthon po'i rtse la sba'o// ri de sus mthong ba thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'gyur ro// rin chen ḍā ki nī'i thugs kar/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shā ni zas nor thams cad dbang du sdus shig ces bris pa ga'ur gzhug de thab kyi dkyil du sba'o// des zas nor thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro// nor sgrub rkyang pa la nor gcig pu'i sgrub pas chog ma mtha' yang gtor ma dang chu gtor gang rung chag med du bya'o// zhag re la sngags ci nus re bzlas pas zas nor thams cad 'phral du 'du ba yin gsungs so// phan yon yang dpag tu med do// gong gi yon tan rnams dang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing khams su skye ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med do// ༈ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā nas po ta la'i 'gram nas phar byon pas mi zhig 'chi zhing gda' skad/ paṇ+ḍi tas ci nyes skad/ mi des na re bkres nas 'chi ba yin skad/ paṇ+ḍi ta snying rje chen po skyes nas bsam pa/ grong khyer du bsod snyoms slong du phyin na kho 'chi bar 'dug nga rang gi sha bcad nas sbyin snyam nas/ lhung bzed nas spu gri phyung ste sku sha bcad nas byin pas/ mi de na re/ nga sha mi za zer nas zar ma nyan/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal nas zos pas yud tsam zhig srog thub ste 'ong*/ de nas grong khyer nas bsod snyoms byas nas 'ong gi byas pas/ mi de na re spyir yang sha mi za/

de'i nang nas kyang chos pa'i sha mi za/ 'phags pa'i bden pa ma mthong ba'i sems can sdug bsngal gyi rkyen gyis 'chi bas/ nga yang skyes nas mi 'chi ba la dbang med ces smras pa dang*/ jo bo'i thugs la/ bden sems can bkres pa'i sdug bsngal la bsam pa na nga'i snying gis gar tshugs gsungs nas ri bo ta lar dbu bstan/ zhal sa la bstan nas bshum zhing bzhugs pa dang*/ sa g.yos shing nam mkha' la sgra chen po byung bas spyan phyis nas gzigs pas/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs byon nas/ ci nyes gsungs pas/ jo bos mi bkres nas 'chi ba sogs gong bzhin zhus pas/ 'phags pa spyan chab phyung ste/ spyan chab g.yon nas jo mo sgrol ma byon/ spyan chab g.yas nas dzaṃ bha la dkar po lha lnga byon nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'od kor re 'dug pa gzigs/ jo bo thugs mnyes nas bstod pa mdzad do// dzam+bha la'i zhal nas mu tig gi char babs so// jo bo la byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba mdzad do// jo bo'i zhal nas sngags 'di ma chag par bzlas na skyid par 'ong gsungs/ lo tsā ba'i zhal nas/ jo bo'i mgon po lcam dral gyi gdams pa gcig tu bzhag pa bas 'di lhag 'di la gang zag gis lag len byas na tshe 'di'i dbul ba sel ba yin gsungs/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba na re/ jo bo'i mgon po lcam dral gyi sgrub thabs mang yang*/ dgos pa che ba ni tshe 'di la bkres pa'i sdug bsngal sel/ tshe phyi mar spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob pa yin pas 'di dga' gsungs so// yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ nor bdag sgrub pa'i gang zag la dgos pa gnyis yod gsungs/ tshe 'di la zas nor gyis mi phongs/ phyi mar snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhing khams su skye gsungs so// lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge'i zhal nas/ nyams su len pa'i mi yod na tshe 'di'i dbul ba sel bar 'dug gsungs so// jo bo'i zhal nas 'di nyams su len pa la nor bdag rang gi ga'u 'dzom nas sgrub pa ni rab/

'bring tha ma gnyis byas na chu sbyin dang gtor ma nar mar gtong ba dang rnam par mi rtog pa'i sngags nub re la brgya rtsa re ma chag na shin tu skyid cing zas nor lhun grub tu 'ong ste sgrub nus pa mi 'dug gsung nas bka' rgya dam par mdzad do// lo tsā ba brtson 'grus seng ge'i zhal nas/ jo bo'i gdams pa 'di la chos skor bzhi yod gsungs/ srog thun dug gi spu gri/ tshe sgrub rdo rje 'khyil pa/ pho rkyang mo rkyang btsan thabs su btags pa/ nor sgrub rin chen spungs pa dang bzhi las/ 'di nor sgrub rin chen spungs pa'o// bal yul du nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal bas zhus pas/ lo tsā ba brtson 'grus seng ge la gdams ngag bzhi ka gnang nas nga la ma gnang*/ slar brtson 'grus seng ges nga la ma dris par jo bo la zhu bar mi rigs gsungs pa dang*/ jo bos 'di'i bka' rgya dam po mdzad pas ma zhus gsungs/ dus phyis jo bo la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang dang yang du byas te zhus pas gnang gsungs so// ༈ /bla ma dang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// dzam+bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ zla ba yar ngo'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bzang po la gnas dben par phyags dar bla bre yol ba bres/ rten dgram/ maṇ+ḍal gyi gzhi dri bzang pos chag chag btab la/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser// bden bral ljang la dbang ldan nag /lte ba dkar la sogs spyi dang mthun par bri/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ mchod pa ci 'byor bzang du bsham/ gzhan yang rjes gnang gi chas rin chen rgyan phreng dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ be con dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rten 'brel gyi rdzas sna tshogs pa blugs pa'i snod dang*/ nor bu dang*/ bum pa bcud kyis bkang ba kha rgyan dang bcas pa dang*/ pad+ma/ lcags kyu/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ne'u le'i rkyal bu/

gtor ma zas sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ tsā ru'i bza' ba rnams sta gon bya/ de nas mchod pa byin brlab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gtso bo dzaṃ dkar gyi bsgom bzlas dang mchod bstod bya/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lta bu zhig bskyed/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu cho ga gsum las gtso 'khor lngar bskyed/ bzlas pa/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'dod don gsal gdab sgrub thabs ltar bya/ de nas slob ma la khrus byas stan la 'dug gu gul gyis bdug me tog dang bcas pas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug rtog pa bsdu/ kun slong 'chos/ yid ches lo rgyus bshad/ gnang ba byin/ slob ma lhar bskyed sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod/ thun mong gi sdom pa gzung*/ ye shes dbab/ dus gsum bde gshegs sku yi mchog /sku dang ye shes rgyas pa'i sku// sku mchog 'di ni khyod kyis zungs// lus kyi mi dge spang bar bya// sngags kyi mjug tu oṃ zhes so// sku yi rig gtad dbu rgyan bskon// dar dpyangs rin chen rgyan phreng sbyin// gsung gi rig gtad bzlas lung sbyin// me tog dang bcas pa'i phreng ba slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag go /bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/ de'i gdams ngag bshad/ de nas thugs kyi rig gtad la/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso 'khor gsal gdab/ sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes gsum las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum dang*/ gtso 'khor lnga kha dog sna tshogs tshon gang ba dpag med 'phros slob ma'i snying gar zhugs pas thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thob par bsam/ de nas gtso bo'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ rje btsun dzaṃ la dkar po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// bu yis myur du thob par shog

/oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ slob ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar bskyed la/ g.yas su rdo rje/ g.yon du rten 'brel gyi rdzas sna tshogs blugs pa'i snod gtad la/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs kyi zhes sogs brjod nas/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi shā ni steng lha'i srid pa rigs kyi bu'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ 'og klu'i srid pa/ bar mi'i srid pa rigs kyi bu'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ slob ma rin chen mkha' 'gro mar bskyed la/ g.yas su rin po che/ g.yon du bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa gtad la/ bcom ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs kyi zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shā ni 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas thams cad rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ slob ma pad+ma mkha' 'gro mar bskyed la/ g.yas su pad+ma/ g.yon du lcags kyu gtad de/ bcom ldan pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni/ rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ yul mi dbang che ba dang*/ nor bu'i bdag po klu chen po rnams rdo rje slob ma 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ slob ma las kyi ḍā ki mar bskyed la/ g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon du ne'u le'i rkyal bu gtad la/ bcom ldan las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs kyi= zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni/ yul mi phyug po dang zas nor sna tshogs pa rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes lha bsgom pa dang*/ phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang bya/ de nas gtor ma rgyan can de lha lngar gsal gdab/ gtor ma'i dbang gi dmigs pa'i ngo sprad de gtor dbang bya/ lha lnga po slob ma'i spyi bor bstim/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod de/ me tog slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag

de nas gtor ma slob ma la sbyin/ stong gsum 'di'am brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ 'dir phyag rten gang phul ba de dngos grub kyi thog mar 'ong ba yin par nor lha rnams kyi man ngag tu 'byung zhing*/ slob dpon la yon bzang du phul na dngos grub myur pa'i rten 'brel yod ces gsungs pas de ltar bya/ dam tshig bsdus te khas blang*/ de'i don bshad/ de nas mdun bskyed la gtang rag gi mchod bstod bya/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te maṇ+ḍal bsdu/ bsngo ba smon lam bya/ bkra shis brjod/ tsā ru'i bza' ba la longs spyod cing dga' ston bya'o// rje btsun dzam+bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang gi tho dpal ldan a ti sha'i man ngag las byung ba bla ma rnams kyi gsung zhing yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /jo bos mdzad pa'i bstod pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan chab las 'khrungs nor bdag rin chen brjid pa'i sku// gangs ri ltar dkar rab mdzes 'gro tshogs dbul phongs tha dag sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad cing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum 'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse phyogs bcu kun tu gzigs mdzad pa// bsam 'phel nor bu dpag bsam shing 'dra de la bdag yid gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dug gsum la sogs ngan 'gro'i sa bon myu gu gcod mdzad phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin// g.yon pas be con nor bdag ma lus dbang du sdud cing bkres skom nad dang sdug bsngal 'joms// dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes shing len bu'i cod pan lhab lhub rgyan gyis kun nas mdzes// nor bdag chen po 'brug la chibs pas bdag dang sems can kun gyi dbul phongs zhi bar mdzod// gangs ri ltar dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'brug gi steng na brjid pa'i sku// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul 'gro la 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa// yi dam khyod la gus pas 'dud do byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// log 'tsho bral ba'i 'byor pa chen po kun nas rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol//

༈ /'phags pa dzam+bha la dkar po'i bsgom bzlas rjes gnang byed tshul dang bcas pa bzhugs so// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dzam+bha la dkar po bsgrub par 'dod pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dzam̐ las dzam+bha la dkar po 'brug la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon pas be con bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs shing 'dzum pa'i rnam pa can/ spyan gsum pa dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o// 'di la yan lag bzhi rdzogs byed gsungs pa ni mi snang la/ byed na/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la dzam̐ yig dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la dkar po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ snying gar zla ba la dzam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng las 'od 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi zas nor thams cad 'dus par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa dang*/ bstod pas bstod/ 'dod don gsol gdab byas la/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba bya/ rjes gnang byed na/ zla ba yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sogs pa la rgyal phur 'dzom pa'am/

de min skar ma rgyal la sogs pa gza' skar 'dzom pa la gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal rdul tshon gyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshon rdzogs spyi dang mthun pa lte ba dkar ba'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ mthar mchod pas bskor/ dkar gtor rgyan ldan che ba gcig bsham/ dam rdzas rin po che'i rgyan phreng sogs tsaka li bsham/ rang rten la kha phyogs par 'dug la/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ skyabs 'gro nas mchod bstod kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khang bzang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su dzam̐ las rtse gsum dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa las dzam+bha la dkar po sgrub thabs bzhin/ shar gyi 'dab ma la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje ḍā ki nī nam mkha'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje/ g.yon pas rten 'brel gyi nor rdzas bsnams pa/ lhor trām̐ las rin po che trām̐ gyis mtshan pa las rin chen ḍā ki nī ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu pam̐ las pad+ma pam̐ gyis mtshan pa las pad+ma ḍā ki nī dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ byang du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa las/ las kyi ḍā ki nī ljang gu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram/ g.yon ne'u le nor skyugs pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// 'dir yan lag bzhi rdzogs thob pa 'dra yang bshad pa mi snang*/ byed na rigs lnga so sos dbur brgyan par mdzad pas chog par snang ngo*// de nas oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra re re bzhin sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ sgos bstod ma shes na/ nor gyi dbang phyug gis bstod/

gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs par gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ slar mchod bstod 'dod don zhu/ de nas gtso 'khor la dmigs la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya sogs ci nus bzla/ slob ma ji ltar rigs pa gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkram bsdu tshar nas/ ༈ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rjes gnang zab mo gsan snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir chos thams cad kyi snying po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nor lha mang po'i nang nas/ jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la dkar po'i rjes gnang zab mo sgrub par byed pa la sngon du brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha skabs zhig ri po ta la'i 'gram na phar byon pas mi gcig 'chi zhing 'dug pa gzigs/ jo bos khyod la nad gang byung nas 'chi ba yin dris pas/ mi de na re bkres nas 'chi ba yin zer skad/ jo bo snying rje chen po skyes te grong khyer du bsod snyoms slong du phyin na de'i bar la kho 'chi bar 'dug nga rang gi sha bcad la sbyin snyam nas lhung bzed nas spu gri phyung nas sku sha bcad nas byin pas mi de na re ngas mi sha mi za zer nas bzar ma nyan/ jo bo'i zhal nas zos pas yud tsam zhig srog thub ste 'ong de bar la ngas grong khyer nas bsod snyoms byas pa khyer nas yong gi byas pas/ mi de na re/ spyir yang sha mi za/ de'i nang nas kyang chos pa'i sha mi za/ 'phags pa'i bden pa ma mthong ba'i sems can sdug bsngal gyi rkyen gyis 'chi bas/ nga skyes nas mi 'chi ba'i dbang med/ ces smras pas/ jo bo'i thugs la bden sems can bkres pa'i sdug bsngal bsam na/

nga'i snying gis gar tshugs gsungs nas ri po ta lar dbu bstan/ zhal sa la bstan nas bshum zhing bzhugs pa dang*/ sa g.yos shing nam mkha' la sgra chen po byung bas/ spyan phyis nas gzigs pas/ zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs byon nas ci nyes gsungs pas/ jo bos mi bkres nas 'chi ba sogs gong bzhin zhus pas/ 'phags pa yang spyan chab phyung ste/ spyan g.yon nas jo mo sgrol ma byon/ spyan g.yas nas dzam+bha la dkar po lha lnga byon nas mdun gyi nam mkhar 'od gor re bzhugs pa gzigs nas jo bo thugs mnyes nas bstod pa mdzad do// jo bo la byin rlabs dang rjes su gnang ba mdzad do// jo bo'i zhal nas/ 'di'i bsgom bzlas ma chag par byas na skyid par 'ong gsungs/ jo bo la tshe sgrub rdo rje 'khyil pa dang*/ nor sgrub rin chen spungs pa la sogs gdams pa khyad par can bzhi yod pa las 'di nor sgrub yin/ 'di la chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa/ gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa/ ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa dang gsum yod/ 'di lo tsā ba rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang*/ nag tsho ba gnyis la gnang ba las/ nag tsho las brgyud pa 'phel te deng sang gi bar du bka' ma nub par bzhugs pa 'di yin no// da rjes gnang dngos la sngon du slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can gyis gsol ba gdab na'ang rung ba 'dra/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po'i yid kyis nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob// ces gsungs pas sems rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs dran bzhin pas rgyud dag par byed pa'i slad du rgyun bshags mdzad dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/

mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dzam+bha la dkar po'i lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams dzam+bha la dkar po zhes sogs bskyed/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dzam+bha la dkar po'i rnam pa dang mdun bskyed nas kyang de 'dra ba'i gtso 'khor lnga'i sku dpag tu med pa byon khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mang du brjod/ dril bu gsil/ gu gul gyis bdug slob ma la mchod bstod cig bya/ de nas dzam+bha la'i tsakli slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ dbu rgyan dar dpyangs sbyin zer ba yig rnying na snang*/ dus gsum bde gshegs sku yi mchog /sku dang ye shes rgyas pa'i sku// sku mchog 'di ni khyod kyis zungs// lus kyi me dge spang bar bya// oṃ pad+ma kro dha nas hṛ da ya oṃ/ zhes brjod pas slob ma la dzam+bha la thim par bsam/ des sku'i rjes gnang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon dang sngags phreng las/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar dzam̐ yig gi mthar lan dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ pad+ma kro dha lan gsum gyi rjes zlos/ me tog phul la/

bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs spyi dang mthun/ des gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ mdun bskyed gtso 'khor lnga'i gnas gsum la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum dang*/ gtso 'khor lnga'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gsil/ gu gul gyis bdug des thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang la/ khyed rang rnams dzam+bha lar gsal ba la phyag mtshan gtad par mos pa mdzod byas la/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan gyi tsakli gtad la/ rje btsun dzam la dkar po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// bu yis myur du thob par shog /oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yang khyed rang rnams rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar gsal ba la phyag mtshan gtad pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// zhes sogs rkang pa phyi ma gnyis gong bzhin/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni pi shā ni steng lha srid dbang du gyur cig 'og klu srid dbang du gyur cig bar mi srid dbang du gyur cig rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes sbyin/ yang khyed rang rnams rin chen ḍā ki mar gsal ba la phyag mtshan byin pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shā ni 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas thams cad rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod/ yang khyed rang rnams pad+ma mkha' 'gro mar gsal ba sogs/ bcom ldan pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i// sogs dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni rgyal po dang*/

blon po dang*/ yul mi dbang che ba dang*/ nor gyi bdag po klu chen po rnams slob ma 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod/ khyed rang rnams las kyi ḍā ki mar gsal ba sogs dang*/ bcom ldan las kyi zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni yul mi phyug po dang zas nor sna tshogs pa rigs kyi bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod pa ni yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma rgyan ldan bzung la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid rin po che'i khang bzang gi dbus su dzam+bha la dkar po lha lngar gsal ba'i steng gi cha la bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ mtha' skor du chos skyong srung ma nor lha'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa'i dus su brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis kyang bka' bsgos pa la brten nas/ nor bdag 'khor bcas khyed rang rnams kyi dbang du gyur pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ jo bo rje/ rgya brtson 'grus seng ge/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ bshes gnyen 'brom ston pa/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ spyan snga bsod nams 'phel/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge/ srib ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ lha phug pa rin chen 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan grub pa/ rin po che sangs rgyas 'od zer/ gtsang pa blo bzang*/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya bzang po/ spyan snga ba bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ spyan snga sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa

'di man kha skong*/ sngags 'chang kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin rnams kyi bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar/ dzam+bha la dkar po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis slob ma 'di rnams kyi nor lha mdzad nas srid pa gsum gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dbang du bsdus nas bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ oṃ pad+ma sogs nas/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na adhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ gtor ma lha lngar gsal ba khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ gtor ma nas dngos grub kyi tshul du cung zad bcad la slob ma la sbyin bzar gzhug me tog gtor la/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan par byas/ de ltar de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ dge ba bsngo/ slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ de nas mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa sogs bzod par gsol/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis brjod nas las rjes bsdu'o// zhes pa 'di ni sngar gyi yig rnying gsal bar gyis shig ces bco brgyad rin po ches bka' gnang ba la brten nas/ rang gi sems la nges pa gang rnyed pa she'u lo tsās nā len+d+rar bris pa'o// bla ma'i phyag len dang yig cha gsar pa khungs thub rnyed na da dung dpyad par bya'o// 'dis 'gro ba mtha' dag gi dbul ba sel gyur cig/ ༈ /dzaṃ dkar rjes gnang khams gsum dbang sdud bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa ra dzam+bha lā ya/ thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// 'gro ba'i dbul phongs sdug bsngal sel ba'i phyir// 'dod dgu'i 'byung khungs ār+ya dzam+bha la// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// gang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang cho gar bcas// 'khrul med dam pa gong ma'i gzhung bzang bzhin// rang dang skal mnyam don du gsal bar bshad// yar ngo'i dus bzang bkra shis par// dben pa'i gnas su stegs kyi khar// maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus// tshom bu dkar dang phyogs bzhi ru// shar sngo lho ser nub dmar dang*// byang du ljang ba'i tshom bu dgod// zlum gtor chu gnyis nyer spyod dang*// dbang rdzas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga be con// rdo rje bcud snod nor bu bum// pad+ma lcags kyu rgya gram dang*// ne'u le'i rkyal pa la sogs pa// 'bur dang bris pa gang rung bsham// rdor dril me tog maṇ+ḍal dang*// gu gul la sogs slob ma la// dgos pa'i yo byad 'du bya'o// mchod pa rnams la a mṛ tas bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i mthar dril gsil bya zhing*/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇis byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar byas la/ rang skad cig gis dzam+bha lar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la la bla ma 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs tshogs zhing spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥpad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs phyag bya/ gong gi sngags sham du ar+ghaṃ sogs btags nas mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi ni/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid dzam̐ dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams can/ yid tsam khros pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes shing*/ sma ra smin ma dkar ser gyen du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i be con bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ se mo do/ 'og pags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub rnams kyis spras shing*/ dar gyi yug gon stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'phyangs zhing*/ pañtsa li ka'i sham thabs can/ g.yu 'brug gi steng na zhabs gnyis phyed skyil gyi tshul du bzhugs pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla gdan la dzam̐ dkar po 'od zer 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dzam+bha la dkar po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ shel dkar zhun ma'i phung por dbang gzhu yis// rab dkris gar dgu'i nyams ldan gnod sbyin dbang*// 'dod dgu'i dngos grub char ltar 'bebs mdzad pa// dpal ldan dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i gdan la dzam̐ yig dkar po mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par khams gsum gyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad bsdus te ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma las// 'dod dgu'i dpal ster rab brjid gnod sbyin dbang*// dbul phongs sdug bsngal kun sel nor gyi lha// mgon po dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan 'das mgon po dzam+bha las bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa'i 'tsho ba spangs nas chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod skal pa dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/

yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sh+lo ka gcig gi mthar/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs par bsam/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dzam̐ dkar po zhes pa nas bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ shar du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon rten 'brel gyi snod/ lhor trām̐ las rin po che trām̐ gyis mtshan pa las rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo g.yas nor bu/ g.yon bum pa/ nub tu pam̐ las pad+ma pam̐ gyis mtshan pa las pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon lcags kyu/ byang du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu g.yas rgya gram/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ dbu skra ser po thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yon bskums g.yas brkyangs ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ zhes pa nas dkar po'i bar gong bzhin las/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i/ zhes sbyar nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la rin chen 'byung ldan/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro la 'od dpag med/ las kyi mkha' 'gro la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod gong bzhin la/ las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub la thogs med cing*// rnam 'phrul ma nges sprul pa phyogs bcur 'gyed// gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad mkha' 'gro ma// sgyu ma'i gzugs can bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces sbyar/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ zhes pa nas/ nang du bar mchod pa bzhin las/ gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ sngags la/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pas dbul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob ma khrus byas gu gul gyis bdug gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad spyi dang yig rnying las byung ba'i lo rgyus bshad/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ 'od zer gyis lus sbyangs nas/ dzam+bha la gtso 'khor du bskyed/ ye shes dbab/ slob ma dzam+bha lar gsal ba la mchod bstod byas nas/ dzaṃ dkar gyi sku spyi bor bzhag ste/ dus gsum bde gshegs sku yi mchog /sku dang ye shes rgyas pa'i sku// sku mchog 'di ni khyod kyis zungs// lus kyi mi dge spang bar bya// sngags kyi mjug tu/ oṃ zhes brjod pas dbang bskur/ yang sku rgyan gyi tsaklis kyang lus la rgyan 'dogs tshul byas la/ sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ zhes brjod cing ster ba ni sku'i rig gtad do// rang dang slob ma dzam+bha lar gsal ba'i snying gar sngags phreng bkod nas bzlas lung spyi 'gre byas pa gsung gi rigs gtad do// mdun bskyed dang slob ma'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsal btab nas/ mdun bskyed las yig 'bru gsum dang gtso 'khor lnga byon nas slob ma'i snying gar thim pas thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo// slob ma'i g.yas su kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ g.yon du be con gtad nas/ rje btsun dzam̐ la dkar po yi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// bu yis myur du thob par shog /gtso bo'i sngags brjod/ de bzhin du slob ma la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rim bzhin bskyed la g.yas g.yon du rdo rje dang rdzas snod gtad nas/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs kyi sogs gong bzhin mthar/

oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi shā ni lha klu'i srid pa thams cad bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ yang rin po che dang bum pa gtad nas/ bcom ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i// sku gsung thugs sogs mthar// oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pa shā ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas thams cad bu 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ yang pad+ma dang lcags kyu gtad la/ bcom ldan pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i// sogs mthar/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni rgyal blon yul mi dbang chen nor bu sogs bu 'di'i sogs gong bzhin/ yang rgya gram dang ne'u le gtad la/ bcom ldan las kyi mkha' 'gro sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni phyug po zas nor sna tshogs bu 'di'i sogs gong bzhin brjod pa ni/ lha bsgom pa dang phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang ngo*// gtor ma lha lngar gsal btab la/ brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa'i gtor dbang dkyus bzhin 'dra la/ lha lnga spyi bor thim par mos nas/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag pas brtan par byas la bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol/ gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ gshegs gsol/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis rnams spyi ltar ro// brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ dpal ldan a ti sha /rgya brtson 'grus seng ge/ nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ po to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ skyi ston smon lam tshul khrims/ spyan snga bsod nams chos 'phel/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge/ srib ri ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ lha phug pa rin chen 'od zer/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ sangs rgyas 'od zer/ blo gros bzang po/ shākya bzang po/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang*/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ she'u lo tsā ba/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/

byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po/ des bdag la'o// zhes jo lugs kyi dzaṃ dkar lha lnga'i rjes gnang bya tshul khams gsum dbang sdud 'di'ang sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis rang dang skal mnyam rnams la phan pa'i ched du bkod pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dzam+bha la dkar po phyi chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal kun thugs rje'i zla ba rgyas pa'i dpal// mtha' dag zhun mar 'khyil ba'i lang tsho can// puṇ+ḍa rī kas mtshan pa'i 'phags pa dang*// dbyer med dpal ldan bla mar phyag bgyis nas// lha mchog 'gro la gzigs pa'i spyan ras las// rnam par 'khrungs pa'i rmugs 'dzin dkar po de// gtsang ma'i chab rgyun la brten sgrub pa'i thabs// dngos grub 'dod 'jo nor bu'i rdzing bu 'bri// de'ang jo bo dī paṃ ka ra nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la dkar po sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa zab mo mang du mchis pa las/ 'dir phyi chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ mdun du zangs gzhong nang du nor bdag gi sku lugs ma'am/ rdo dkar las brkos pa'am/ rdza las bcos pa chu thub pa'i so btang ba'am/ de rnams ma 'byor na tsa ka li bris pa la sbrang rtsis byugs pa'i rab gnas can smyug ma phra ba la btags nas rdo'i gdan la btsugs pa bzhugs/ logs shig tu bum pa chu gtsang gis bkang ba'ang bzhag rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas/ ༈ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ mdun gyi sku gzugs la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ dzam̐ las kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum pa dzam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dzam+bha la dkar po 'brug sngon po la chibs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum pa dang*/ g.yon be con bsnams pa/ zhal gdangs pa 'dzum dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun du rdo rje mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang g.yon rten 'brel gyi nor rdzas bsnams pa/

lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas nor bu rin po che dang g.yon bum pa bcud kyis gang ba bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa nor gyis gang ba bsnams pa/ kun kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i gar stabs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rje btsun dzam+bha la 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ bum pa nas nor bdag gi spyi bor mar chu blug cing*/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ chu mu tig gi phreng bar gyur cing*/ nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal nas kyang mu tig gi char phab nas bdag la dngos grub stsol bar bsams la/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon po'i spyan chab las 'khrungs nor bdag rin chen brjid pa'i sku// gangs ri ltar dkar rab mdzes 'gro tshogs dbul phongs mtha' dag sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad cing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum 'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse phyogs bcu kun tu gzigs mdzad pa// bsam 'phel nor bu dpag bsam shing dang 'dra la bdag yid gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dug gsum la sogs ngan 'gro'i sa bon myu gu gcod mdzad phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin// g.yon pas be con nor bdag ma lus dbang du sdud cing bkres skom nad dang sdug bsngal 'joms// dbu skra dkar ser gyen du brdzes shing len bu'i cod pan lhab lhub rgyan gyis kun nas mdzes// nor bdag chen po 'brug la chibs pas bdag dang sems can kun gyi dbul phongs zhi bar mdzod// ces pas bstod la/

nor bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab cing*/ chu sbyin gyi chu las mtheb srin gyis chu thigs gcig blangs la rang gi lce thog tu bzhag ste dngos grub blang*/ mdun gyi lha rnams rang gi snying gar thim par bsams la/ yig brgya bzla zhing chu phyogs bzhir gtor/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du zhes sogs dang*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas gdab cing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// de ltar nyams su blangs pas chos mthun gyi nor rdzas char ltar 'bab pa sogs gzhung nas bshad pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ngo*// 'phags yul mkhas pa'i dbang phyug a ti sha'i// thugs bcud dbang gi rgyal po 'di yod bzhin// 'bad kyang 'dod pa ster la nges med pa'i// mching bu nor bur rlom pa'i re ba bskyungs// zhes dzam+bha la dkar po phyi chu sbyin la brten nas sgrub pa dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba 'di ni sngon gyi yig rnying las 'byung ba bla ma'i phyag gzhes kyis brgyan te mkhas mchog bla ma bkra shis dbang phyugs pas mdzad par lung rgyun ma byung gshis/ slad kyis ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis/ 'di'i yig rnying man ngag sgrub skor gyi rigs rnams legs par mnos nas/ slar dbri bskyed dang mgo gsham gyi tshigs su bcad pa'i zhabs 'degs bcas zhus pa bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༈ /dzam+bha la dkar po nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i chu rgyun las// legs 'khrungs 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba'i lha// rab brjid gangs kyi lhun po zla zer gyis// lan brgyar 'khyud 'dra de la gus btud de// 'dod yon gya nom rang bzhin ba lin+ta'i// rnal 'byor la gnas sgra brgya'i bzhon pa can// dgyes par bskyed pas dngos grub 'dod pa dgu// khur du 'dren pa'i rin chen shing rta brtsam// de'ang jo bo dī paṃ ka ra nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa las/

'dir nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa ni/ rgyud las/ 'bras chan zho dang 'o ma mar// ming ni dkar gsum po zhes gsungs// zhes pa ltar/ 'byor na 'bras chan zho dang mar gyis sbrus pa'am/ ma 'byor na phye gtsang ma zho mar gyis sbrus pa'i gtor ma dbyibs dzam gtor gyi rnam pa la mar gyis byugs nas kha dog dkar por byas pa rgyan ldan che zhing mdzes pa'i mthar dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi bza' bca' mang pos bskor ba zangs gzhong sogs rin po che'i snod du bsham/ bu ram ni bya rgyud spyi la bkag pas mi rung ngo*// 'o ma sogs btung ba'i rnam pa'ang mang du blug mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod mthong brgyud ltar bsham/ rang nyid dzaṃ dkar gyi bsgom bzlas bya ba'am/ chu sbyin skabs su bshad pa'i kha sar+pā ni'i sgrub thabs gang rung sngon du 'gro bas/ ༈ /gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ mdun du rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su zhes pa nas ye shes pa bstim pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa ba l̥ṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pas phul bas mnyes par bsams la/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ chu sbyin skabs kyi bstod pa'am/ yang na/ thugs rje chen po'i spyan chab las 'khrungs shing*// rtse gsum dbyug pas dug gsum dbul ba sel// gnas skabs mthar thug dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba// yid bzhin nor bu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes jo bos mdzad pa 'dis bstod la/

nor bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos dang mthun pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mdun gyi lha rnams rang gi snying gar thim par bsams la/ skabs su bab pa'i bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab/ gtor ma bya khyi sogs gzhan la mi sbyin par dngos grub kyi tshul du rang gis longs spyad do// 'di ni thun mtshams sogs skabs gzhan du bya ba'i tshul yin la/ chu sbyin dang sbrel na/ sbyor ba'i skabs zangs gzhong du 'phags pa'i sku bzhag pa'i mdun du dkar gsum gyis sbags pa'i dzaṃ gtor bsham/ 'o ma chu gtsang sogs btung ba'i rnam pa mang du blug chu sbyin phul tshar ba'i mtshams su 'bru gsum lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ gong ltar dbul/ mchod bstod man chad chu sbyin ltar bya'o// dpyid dus pad+ma'i bsung gis bdud rtsi'i mgrin// dga' ba'i 'phur lding dang bcas 'gugs pa 'dis// sgrub pa'i thabs 'dis srid zhi'i phun tshogs sgo// nor sbyin dbang po dgyis pa'i ya mtshan ngom// zhes dzam+bha la dkar po nang gtor ma la brten nas sgrub pa 'dod dgu'i 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di'ang yig rnying las 'byung ba ltar brgyud pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan te/ mkhas dbang bla ma bkra shis dbang phyug gis mdzad par slad kyis ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis yig rnying dang bstun zhu bstar sogs bgyis pa'i bkra shis par gyur cig/ ༈ /dzam+bha la dkar po gsang ba ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa rin po che dbang gi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bsil ldan sems can 'khor ba'i duḥkha las// 'don byed phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje yi// rang gzugs rmugs 'dzin zla ba'i bzhin ras can// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gror bcas pas dge legs stsol// gang de'i sgrub thabs sngon byon mkhas pa'i gzhung*// rnam dpyod lha yi bzo bos legs bskrun pa// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po'i za ma tog

/'dod dgu char du bsnyil slad 'dir kha phye// 'dir jo bo dī paṃ ka ra nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa las/ gsang ba ga'u la brten nas sgrub pa la gnyis te/ nor bdag gi ga'u la brten nas nor bsgrub pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i ga'u la brten nas dbang du bsdu ba'o// de'i dang po la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba ni/ rdzas la rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye ma bsres pa'i 'jim pa las ga'u zlum po'am gru bzhi gang rung rgya dang dpangs sor bcu drug las mi chung ba zhig bya/ nas 'bras gro la sogs pa 'bru rigs gang 'byor skar ma bre dang lug gi nyi ma la bsag gser dngul mu tig mu men zangs lcags la sogs pa rin po che'i rigs gang 'byor skar ma rgyal sa ri sa ga gang rung dang gza' spen pa 'dzom pa la bsag mar thud la sogs pa zas kyi rigs thams cad gza' skar bzang po la bsag 'bri g.yag lug la sogs pa phyugs sna tshogs kyi spu rnyed tshad skar ma sgrog la bsag go /gzhan yang mi rigs bzang po dbang po tshang ba g.yang can bkra shis pa'i lag nas gos sna sman sna zas sna la sogs pa mdor na sa steng bkra shis pa'i rdzas sna rnyed tshad/ so so'i g.yang skar ram gza' skar bzang po la bsags la ga'ur blug go /'on kyang bra bo sran nag yungs nag sogs 'bru nag dang*/ rta bong mdzo dre'u phag rnams kyi spu dang*/ sha chang la sogs pa zas dman pa'i rigs ni ma yin no// de nas rab rin po che'am/ sa la rin po che bsres pa'i lde gu las nor bdag gi sku sor bzhi las mi chung bar bya/ de'i nang du chos sku'i ring bsrel sogs gzhug tshul rgyas bsdus skabs su bab pa spyi ltar dang*/ mi phyug po g.yang can gyi khang pa'i sa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzang po'i gzim khang gi sa/ zhing mu ma'i sa dang*/ rin po che'i sna tshogs sa sbyin bzang po dang bsres pas 'brang rgyas ma theb chen gyi rtse mo tsam byas/

de dang lhan cig tu/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shā ni spyir dzam+bu'i gling dang khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid na chos spyod dge ba bcu lhur len pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs brgya stong phrag mang po 'du ba dang*/ chos kyi sbyin bdag tu gyur pa'i rgyal po dang blon po dang btsun mo dang mi chen la sogs pa mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad dang*/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod thams cad sgrub pa po bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes pa rgya shog la gser dngul lam mtshal gyis bris pa dbu nas mar dril ba'i shog dril mang tsam dang*/ dar zab rin po che la sogs pa gong gi rdzas sna tshogs tshad nor bdag gi thugs kar gzhug rtsi tshon btang ba bcas grub rjes/ sbyong khrus sngon du 'gro ba'i rab gnas mdor bsdus gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas pa'i sku gzugs de ga'u'i nang du bcug la/ stegs mtho bar gzhi gtsang ma dkar po'i steng du nas kyi tshom bu dgu bkod pa'i dbus ma'i steng du ga'u dar dkar pos bkab la bzhag de'i mthar nyer spyod la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ dkar gsum gyi gtor ma bza' ba sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'ang bsham/ gzhan yang chu sbyin gyi chas la sogs pa nye bar mkho ba ma tshang ba med pa sta gon bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya rgyud ltar bya/ yig rnying la lar rang nyid dzam+bha lar bsgom par bshad pa ltar na/ she'u lo tsā dang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ltar bzlas pa dang bcas pa grub pa'i rjes sam/ ༈ /yang na chu sbyin skabs su bshad pa'i kha sar+pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs kyis kyang rung bas bzlas pa yan chad grub rjes/ mdun gyi ga'u sku rten dang bcas pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi ga'u rgyu rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i nang du 'jig rten khams kyi lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pas gang bar gyur/

ces dang*/ sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis rgyas par spel/ de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ dzam̐ las kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rtse gsum sogs nas/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i bar chu sbyin gyi sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ yig rnying las nor bdag gtso 'khor lnga skad cig gis bskyed pa la ye shes pa bcug pa sogs mi gsal yang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sgrub thabs las bshad do// de ltar ga'u lha lngar gsal bar bsgoms nas/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ kye/ 'di ni thugs rje chen po nor lha 'phags pa ni// gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// mdog dkar rin chen rgyan bcas zhal gcig phyag gnyis na// rtse gsum be con 'dzin mdzad zhal gdangs 'brug la zhon// dbu skra dkar ser gyen brdzes spyan gsum srid gsum gzigs// 'phags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal mchod do dngos grub slong*// shar du zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes sku// rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas rten 'brel rdzas rnams bsnams// lho ru ser sna rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes sku// rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rin chen g.yon pas bcud kyi bum pa bsnams// nub tu 'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog ye shes sku// pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas pad+ma g.yon pas rin chen lcags kyu bsnams// byang du phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku// las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// g.yas pas rgya gram g.yon pas nor gyi rkyal pa bsnams// kun kyang rin chen rgyan ldan phyed skyil gar gyis bzhengs// mkha' 'gro bzhi la phyag 'tshal mchod bstod dngos grub slong*// nor rnams ster ba med na nor lha'i ming ma mchis// nor rnams ster phyir nor gyi lha ru grags pas na// thugs rje'i phyag rkyong rin chen gter phye nor ster bas// phongs pa'i tshogs rnams dpal dang 'byor pas phyug par mdzod// ces bhe ta badz+ras mdzad pa 'dis kyang bstod do// de nas rang gi dpral bar sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas la mtshams dam du bcad de mi tshig mi bsre bar mdun gyi lha la dmigs te/

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par khams gsum gyi dpal 'byor longs spyod srid zhi'i dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te/ ga'u'i nang gi rten rdzas rnams la thim pas ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hṛ da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces thun re la ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ mkha' 'gro bzhi la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ zhes mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags kyang cung zad bzla/ mthar nor bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pas sogs kyis 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ ༈ /gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs te/ bsang sbyangs nas bstod pa'i bar gong ltar bya/ 'dod gsol 'dir byas kyang chog yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas bye brag tu'ang mdun gyi rten 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos dang thun pa'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ khyad par du rten 'di nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su/ chos spyod dge ba bcu lhur len pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs brgya stong phrag mang po 'du ba dang*/ chos kyi sbyin bdag tu gyur pa'i rgyal po dang blon po dang btsun mo dang mi chen stobs ldan 'byor ldan thams cad dang*/ 'jig rten khams kyi lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rten 'di'i dbang du gyur cig swā hā/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod cing ga'u la me tog gtor bas brtan bzhugs bya/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thugs rje chen po 'grub gyur nas/

bdag bskyed dzam+bha la yin na rmugs 'dzin dbang po zhes bsgyur/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod zad pa med par shog /rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med par// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab/ che ba'i che mchog sogs dang*// 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa sogs bkra shis ji ltar rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// thun mtshams su chu sbyin ma chag par bya/ srod la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la bzhag nas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tshom me le du ka hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa re ma chag par bzlas na zas 'du bar 'gyur ro// de ltar thun bzhi'am gsum gyi rim pas rtse gcig tu bsgrub na/ rab zhag bdun/ 'bring nyer gcig tha ma zla ba gcig nas rtags rnams 'byung ste/ de'ang khrom mang po tshogs pa dang*/ 'bru'i gseb tu nyal ba dang*/ tshur phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ char chen po 'bab pa dang*/ gos gsar pa gyon pa dang*/ 'bul ba mang po byung ba rmis na 'grub pa'i rtags yin no// de ltar byung na gshis kyis lhun grub tu 'byung ngo*// rtags tshang ba dang gong gi sngags kyi mthar mi snying sgul ba'i sngags/ ༈ /oṃ pi shā ni zhes pa spel tshig dang bcas pa sngar bshad pa ltar thun re la ji ltar rigs pa bzla ba zhag bdun nam gsum las mi nyung bar bya/ de'ang bzlas pa dkyus ma'i rjes su sngags spel tshig can bzla ba ma gtogs cho ga gzhan thams cad sngar dang 'dra'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i ga'u de dar gos la sogs pas dril nas bang mdzod du 'bru dang bkra shis pa'i rdzas sna ci 'dzom spungs pa'i dbus su bzhag la/ skabs skabs su mchod gtor dbul/ longs spyod gang byung gi phud kyis mchod cing gzhan gyis ma mthong bar gsang dam par bya/ gtor ma la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas dman pa rnams dngos grub kyi tshul du rang gis longs spyad pa'am/

nye logs su spungs nas bzhag pa las phyir mi gtong ba dang*/ khyad par bya khyi dang ba glang dang mi gzhan la mi sbyin pa ni rten 'brel gyi gnad yin/ gzhan yang g.yang can gyi nor rdzas rnyed na ga'ur blugs pa'am mthar spungs nas bzhag rang la dngos grub gang byung 'dod sred kyis mi bsag par dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ dbul phongs la sbyin pa sogs dge ba'i phyogs la gtong ba nor lha spyi'i dam tshig yin no// ༈ /gnyis pa mkha' 'gro bzhi'i ga'u la brten nas dbang du bsdu ba la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum phal cher sngar dang 'dra ba las/ dang po sbyor ba'i khyad par ni/ sngar bshad pa'i rgyu las nor bdag gi ga'u las sor bzhi tsam chung ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi'i ga'u bya/ gtso 'khor lnga ka'i ga'ur sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon byug mdun rtags mi nor ba'i mtshan ma bya/ sngar bsags pa'i nor rdzas rnams kyis sum gnyis tsam dgang*/ khyad par pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i ga'ur gong gi rdzas kyi steng du dbang lag sogs klu sman rnams blug gtso bo'i sku sngar ltar dang*/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sku gtso bo las chung ba byas la/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shā ni yul 'di zhes pa'i rgyal po dang btsun mo dang blon po la sogs pa che btsan phyug pa'i 'gro ba mang po sgrub pa po bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes gser dngul la sogs kyis bris pa gzhug mgyogs 'gro'i spus lha mo'i rkang pa dkris na myur du 'ong ba yin gsungs/ de bzhin du pad+ma ḍā ki nī'i thugs kar/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shā ni rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ yul mi dbang che ba rnams dang*/ nor bu'i bdag po klu chen po dang*/ yul lha dang*/ yul gyi bdag po thams cad sgrub pa po bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kar oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ pi shā ni steng lha'i srid pa/ bar mi'i srid pa/ 'og klu'i srid pa thams cad sgrub pa po bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kar/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shā ni 'jig rten khams kyi zas nor thams cad sgrub pa po bdag gi dbang du gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bris pa rnams bcug pa rang rang gi ga'ur gzhug pa sogs 'dra'o// tshom bu dbus mar steng du nor bdag gi ga'u/ de'i mdun du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ g.yas su rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyab tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ g.yon du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i ga'u rnams zhal gtso bo la phyogs par dgram/ mchod gtor 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i khyad par ni/ gtso bo'i sngags kyi rjes su/ khyad par du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du rin chen mkha' 'gro sogs la dmigs te/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shā ni swā hā/ zhes pa rnams gtso bo'i bcu cha bzla/ 'di la bsnyen pa'i grangs ma bshad kyang rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgrub bo// yig rnying las/ mkha' 'gro bzhi'i sngags bri ba'i skabs/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sngags gong du bkod pa ltar dang*/ gzhan gsum la hūm̐ phaṭa med pa spel tshig sbyar ba byung na'ang sngags gong ma'i rigs 'gre mdzad par mngon la/ 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba mi gsal yang gtso bo'i skabs kyi shugs las shes so// rtags tshang nas sngags kyi mthar mi snying sgul pa'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bzla ba'ang 'khor sngags spel tshig can bsnan pa ma gtogs 'dra/ bzla bya'i 'khor sngags 'di rnams las sngags dang mi sbrel ba'i tshe gong ltar hūm̐ phaṭa yan dang*/ sbrel ba'i tshe bri ba'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin dgos pa lta bur 'dug kyang*/

hūm̐ phaṭa med pa'i mi snying sgul ba'i sngags dang sbrel ba 'di bzhin rjes gnang gi yig rnying dang*/ ngag dbang chos grags kyi sgrub thabs las byung ba ltar bris pa yin no// gsum pa rjes kyi khyad par ni/ ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ba/ rtswa dang*/ shing dang*/ bya dang ri dwags mang ba/ ri dpyad legs pa/ ri brag thams cad 'dud pa'i tshul du yod pa/ ri gzhan gyi chu rnams kho'i phyogs su 'bab pa/ shin tu bkra shis pa'i ri thang mtshams su phyin la gnas de'i gzhi bdag la bsang dang gtor ma gtong*/ 'dod don sgrub pa'i phrin las bcol/ der sa gting ring du brus la rdo sgrom sogs 'thas par bya/ 'bru sna tshogs cung zad bkram pa'i dbus su las kyi mkha' 'gro'i ga'ur rang la zhal phyogs su bstan te bzhag steng nas g.yam pa dang bar thams cad rde'u sogs kyis bkang nas mi mngon par sba'o// de bzhin du ri de'i lung pa'i chu mgor bsang dang gtor ma gtong*/ khyad par chu de la gnas pa'i klu la klu gtor rgyas bsdus ci rigs btang nas/ phrin las bcol la der pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i ga'u sba'o// des chu de 'thung tshad dbang du 'gyur ba dang*/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ chu de phyi'i rgya mtshor phyin pas klu thams cad dgyes nas nor bu rnams khyer 'ong bar 'gyur ro// de'i tshe gang zag de'i dbang du 'gyur ba yin te mang pos bkur ba lta bur 'gyur gsungs/ ri de'i rtse mor bsang sogs sngar ltar byas la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i ga'u sba'o// des ri de mthong tshad dbang du 'gyur gsungs/ rin chen mkha' 'gro'i ga'u rang gi thab kyi 'og tu sba'o// des zas 'du bar 'gyur ro// 'jig rten dbang du bya bas de ltar bya'o// nor sgrub rkyang pa la nor bdag gi sku gcig pu bsgrub pa las gzhan mi dgos so// nor bdag gi ga'u sngar ltar bang mdzod kyi 'bru'i gseb tu sba'o// de ltar sgrub pa rab 'bring gang rung grub nas rtag tu gtor ma dang chu sbyin gang rung re dang*/
